## Problem

What are you trying to do that seekport makes hard today?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see?

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or other tools you tried.

## Would this need a new dependency?

seekport is intentionally zero-dependency. Please explain how the feature could
be built with the Python standard library, or why a dependency is unavoidable.
